purpose: Separate River Bend reported implementation and public-record route evidence from still-open primary-contract and utility-accounting premises.

verified_premise_groups.use: Supports materiality of the audit; contains forecast uncertainty and scope qualifiers.
Supports FERC/RTO salience and the boundary between context and project proof.
Provides LPSC large-load criteria and Meta/Laidley order conditions for cost assignment, security, reporting, and customer-caused upgrades.
Moves the River Bend public-upside and water layer from generic projection into reported implementation, legal status, and an official resolution route.
Binds financing, electric-infrastructure hold-harmless claims, sales-tax benefit leakage, and partner-stack context.

verified_premise_groups.what_is_now_bound: Council/IDB CEA approval reporting, repayment/signoff/servitude conditions, official hearing risk objections, parent-guarantee enforceability concern, and AAE/UCS requested primary instruments.
what_still_blocks_certification: executed parent guarantee and legal opinion

unverified_decisive_premises.what_is_now_verified: Large-load guidelines, U-37425 conditions, and local reporting that River Bend first-phase switchyard/line costs are not expected to enter rate base.
unverified_decisive_premises.still_missing: Entergy/Hut 8 service, line-extension, interconnection, CIAC, tariff, and ratebase accounting documents; first implementation filings; actual classification of shared vs customer-caused upgrades.
unverified_decisive_premises.next_evidence: Public records request for Entergy/IDB/parish utility-service documents and LPSC/utility workpapers.

unverified_decisive_premises.what_is_now_verified: Hut 8 release claims a $16M water system investment, transfer to parish, closed-loop cooling, water outside residential aquifer, and no local supply impact.
unverified_decisive_premises.still_missing: Signed water agreement, permits, engineering design, aquifer/hydrology analysis, asset-transfer acceptance, and lifecycle O&M cost assignment.
unverified_decisive_premises.next_evidence: Linked parish/public records, permit files, engineering documents, and acceptance/O&M records.

unverified_decisive_premises.what_is_now_verified: Official Act 434 current status; official IDB resolution route; local reporting of a $10M advance, recipient shares, repayment timing, first regular payment estimates, and planned use of funds.
unverified_decisive_premises.still_missing: Signed cooperative endeavor agreement, May 4 IDB resolution PDF text, special-meeting minutes, payment receipt, agency accounting, final budgets, 2027 rebate meeting/vote, and actual tax-bill credits.
unverified_decisive_premises.next_evidence: Read the IDB resolution PDF and CEA; bind payment receipt and 2026 budget/appropriation records; calendar the June 30 2027 rebate meeting trigger.

unverified_decisive_premises: signed cooperative endeavor agreement and July 1 payment receipt
executed parent guarantee/legal opinion/current ESA and financing agreements
water-line servitude, transfer acceptance, and O&M/liability allocation
certification_rule_after_rev0359: The AI/data-center case cannot move from correction_required/not_certified_current to certified_current until all three unverified decisive premises have primary-instrument edges and observed implementation evidence, including contrary evidence tests.

rev0360_delta.certification_boundary: No final certification until signed instruments, payment records, utility accounting, water permits, and contrary-evidence tests are bound.

certification_rule_after_rev0360: A case remains not_certified_current unless decisive premises have primary instruments or observed implementation records plus contrary-evidence tests. Reported payment advances and official routes are material progress but not enough.

rev0361_delta.substantive_move: Converted PILOT prepayment conditions and official/adversarial U-37425 ratepayer-risk record into blocker-grade claim edges.

certification_rule_after_rev0361: Do not certify the AI/data-center case until primary utility-accounting, parent-guarantee/ESA, CEA/PILOT, water, and incentive records are bound with reversal rules and contrary evidence resolved.
